title: nmrForge: automation, parameter optimisation and quality control for Bruker multidimensional NMR data
description: nmrForge automates Bruker multidimensional NMR data processing: it reads acquisition parameters, identifies the experiment type and the sampling scheme, plans and executes an NMRPipe processing strategy (with SMILE reconstruction for non-uniform sampling), performs quality control, and records the resolved parameters, external tool versions and warnings so that a run can be reproduced and audited. This record is the 1.0.0 release: source plus a Linux AppImage, validated end to end on public data (BMRB timedomain entry 53374) with the reproduction scripts shipped in the repository.
